2026.ST10.1.t: Council Member Appointments to the Canadian National Exhibition Association Municipal Section and Board of Directors
2026.ST10.1.s: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of Council Members to the Canadian National Exhibition Association Municipal Section and Board of Directors.
2026.ST10.1.r:
The City Clerk recommends that:

1. The Striking Committee consider Members' preferences and recommend to City Council the appointment of five Council Members to the Canadian National Exhibition Association Municipal Section and Board of Directors, for a term of office from the Annual Meeting in the Spring of 2026 to the Annual Meeting in the Spring of 2027 and until successors are appointed.

m.x:
City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following:

1. City Council appoint the following Members of Council to the Canadian National Exhibition Association Municipal Section and Board of Directors for a term of office starting from the Annual Meeting in the Spring of 2026 to the Annual Meeting in the Spring of 2027, and until successors are appointed:

Councillor Paul Ainslie

Councillor Stephen Holyday

Deputy Mayor Ausma Malik

Councillor Nick Mantas

Councillor Chris Moise

2026.ST10.2.t: Council Member Appointment to Fill a Vacancy on the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee
2026.ST10.2.s: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of a Council Member to fill a vacancy on the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee, resulting from the resignation of Councillor Jennifer McKelvie, effective May 9, 2025.
2026.ST10.2.r:
The City Clerk recommends that:

1. The Striking Committee consider Members' preferences and recommend to City Council the appointment of one Member of Council to the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office until November 14, 2026.

m.x:
City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following:

1. City Council appoint Councillor Neethan Shan to the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office until November 14, 2026.

2026.ST10.4.t: Council Member Appointments to Fill Vacancies on the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors
2026.ST10.4.s: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of three Council Members to fill vacancies on the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors.
2026.ST10.4.r:
The City Clerk recommends that:

1. The Striking Committee consider Members' preferences and recommend to City Council the appointment of three Members of Council to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors for a term of office until November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed.

m.x:
City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following:

1. City Council reappoint Councillor Parthi Kandavel to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors for a term of office until November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
